g.text: Study 3 — Reorganization is coordination, not deliberation
Test per-meeting code-density lift at RMSE
Figure 3. Across all six validated coding schemes, the categories enriched when team communication reorganizes are coordinative/procedural
(information-seeking, feedback, agreement, structuring; teal), while argumentation and solution-construction categories are suppressed (orange).
Bars = mean within-meeting density lift at reorganization events vs baseline; *q<.05, **q<.01, ***q<.001 (BH-FDR).
